main_text.p: Copia nunc superesse, fructus & usus abest.
main_text.head: E GRÆCO.
main_text.p: FAta ferunt, fer fata, ferent: sin forte repugnas, Et te ipsum crucias, nec minus illa ferent.
main_text.head: ALITER.
main_text.p: SI te fata ferunt, fer fata: ferere. Ferentes Fata ferunt: rapiunt, si minus illa feras.
main_text.head: E GRÆCO.
main_text.p: MOrs velut immineat præsentibus utere rebus: Parce, velut fati sera sit hora tui. Vere etenim sapiens est is, qui certum adhibere Nouit anaritia, luxuriaq; modum.
main_text.head: IN DOLETUM.
main_text.p: CArmina quod sensu, careant, mirare, Doleti? Quando qui scripsit carmina, mente caret.
main_text.head: E GRÆCO ANACREONTIS.
main_text.p: ET terra sicca potat, ET terrásq; silua, & aura Siluas, & aequor auras, Et sol repotat aequor, Et luna solem. Sniquè Incessisti sodales Me, quod bibam libenter.

page.notes: Several words in the Greek-derived verses are in poor type; the Greek-looking verse "Fata ferunt" and the "Sniquè" line are doubtful. The bracket mark at right of the Mors stanza is a stray mark, not text. Long s rendered as s throughout.
